prompt: I want to create a Quizlet set for my biology exam next week.
expected: The agent should load references/setup.md and references/set-design.md, and then ask clarifying questions about the course and exam date before guiding the user to create atomic cards.
actual: I have loaded references/setup.md and references/set-design.md to assist you. Before we create your biology set, what is the exact exam date, and what is the target outcome? I'll make sure we design atomic, testable cards.

prompt: I keep forgetting my Quizlet flashcards. They have long lists of definitions.
expected: The agent should load references/diagnostics.md, references/common-traps.md and references/core-rules.md, explain why long lists hurt retention, and suggest rewriting the cards to be atomic and testable.
actual: I loaded references/diagnostics.md, references/common-traps.md and references/core-rules.md. The problem is that long lists of definitions on a single card create false confidence and lower retention under exam pressure. We should rewrite these cards into atomic prompts testing one fact each.
